name: MOLA MEGDR median topography — MEGT44N000HB

source.credit: NASA / MGS MOLA Science Team / PDS Geosciences Node
processing: Decoded 5632 × 11520 SAMPLE_TYPE=MSB_INTEGER, SAMPLE_BITS=16 samples in metres (big-endian signed int16).
Used label record size 23040 bytes and image offset 0 bytes.
Derived projected cell spacing from A_AXIS_RADIUS and MAP_RESOLUTION (128.0 px/degree); MAP_SCALE is rounded in the label and was used as a consistency check.
Block-averaged 17 × 17; blocks with fewer than half valid samples are no-data.
Applied line/sample projection offsets (5632.5, 23040.5) and 128.0 pixels/degree; preserved east-positive coverage.
This derived planner grid has coarser resolution than the source; the source MOLA values are topography above the MOLA areoid.

notes: Numerical MOLA topography above the MOLA areoid; not planetary radius. Product bins may be interpolated where observations are sparse, as stated in its label.
Coordinates use the product's planetocentric latitude and simple cylindrical projection. East-west ground distances and slope are corrected by cos(latitude).
